description: Switch the installed set to a profile: install its skills and remove managed skills not in it. This is the token-saving move — the project ends up with only this profile's skills, so the agent loads only those.

acknowledgeRisk.description: Acknowledge risk for any high-risk skills in the profile.

linkMode.description: How to materialize skills. 'auto' picks junction/symlink with copy fallback.

name.description: Profile to activate. Installs its skills and removes managed skills not in it.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server's working directory.

targets.description: Which tools to install into. Omit to auto-detect (.claude / .agents).

name: activate_profile
title: Activate a skill profile
